name: Musike
subtitle: Unsigned iOS builds from upstream GitHub releases
description: Musike is a free, open-source YouTube Music player by Ernani1234. Standalone on iPhone: no server needed. Builds are the unsigned IPAs published on the upstream release page; SideStore/AltStore re-sign them with your own Apple ID.

apps.name: Musike
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music player, audio only
apps.localizedDescription: Search YouTube Music, build playlists and play audio with the screen off — notification, lock screen and headphone controls. No ads, no account, no server needed on the phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixes

- **Android: search no longer fails on some phones.** On some networks, YouTube rejected the app's search requests, and the app only showed "Search is unavailable right now". The Android app now talks to YouTube the same way the desktop app does, and it tries a second way to search when the first one fails.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ernani1234/musike/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0
